# Verbatim server command lines. <MODEL_DIR> replaces the home directory.
# Environment common to all of them:
#   CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3
#   VLLM_COMPUTE_NANS_IN_LOGITS=1      (engine counts NaN logits ->
#                                       vllm:corrupted_requests_total)
#   VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0
#   VLLM_DEBUG_GDN_PREFIX_STATE=1      (scheduler geometry/split dump)
#   VLLM_DEBUG_FBW=1                   (full first-bad-write trace) or
#   VLLM_DEBUG_FBW=2                   (META lines only; preemption runs)
#   HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1  TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
#   PATH includes the venv and cuda-13.1; caches under a node-local directory
# cudagraph mode is the engine default for this model: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE.

## (1) baseline: every r-sweep cell, the step-7 A/B cells and the frozen control
python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
  --model <MODEL_DIR>/Qwen__Qwen3.8-27B --served-model-name qwen38 \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port <PORT> --tensor-parallel-size 4 --trust-remote-code \
  --dtype bfloat16 --enable-prefix-caching --gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 \
  --max-model-len 32768 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --max-num-seqs 64 \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"ngram","num_speculative_tokens":5,"prompt_lookup_max":5,"prompt_lookup_min":2}' \
  --mamba-cache-mode align --no-enable-log-requests

  reports: GPU KV cache size: 168,068 tokens
           GDN_DBG GEOM cache_config_block_size=816 hash_block_size=816
             mamba_state_block_size=816 mamba_cache_mode=align need_split=True
             groups=[('MambaSpec',816) x3, ('FullAttentionSpec',816)]

## (2) preemption/resume runs: same as (1) with
  --num-gpu-blocks-override 84 --max-num-seqs 8     (VLLM_DEBUG_FBW=2)
  reports: Overriding num_gpu_blocks=454 with num_gpu_blocks_override=84
           GPU KV cache size: 44,395 tokens
           Maximum concurrency for 32,768 tokens per request: 1.35x

## (3) true mamba_cache_mode=none cell: same as (1) with
  --no-enable-prefix-caching --mamba-cache-mode none
  reports: GPU KV cache size: 176,613 tokens
           GDN_DBG GEOM cache_config_block_size=816 hash_block_size=1671168
             mamba_state_block_size=32768 mamba_cache_mode=none need_split=False
             groups=[('MambaSpec',32768) x3, ('FullAttentionSpec',816)]
  NOTE: --mamba-cache-mode none only takes effect because prefix caching is off;
  with prefix caching on the engine overrides it back to align (README §6).

## PIECEWISE control (referenced from the first-bad-write trace): (1) plus
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"PIECEWISE"}'
